notes.title: Patch Demo
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484896/7da21f2949f34fa552468151e57e5dd910904f26.png"]

This week we've fixed a series of bugs in the Lifelong demo. 


These include:
The mascot dance.

Creation of a tutorial for basic movements, jumping, crouching and running.

Added interaction feedback for the salaryman.

Less confusing text for certain characters on the objectives to be achieved.

Less visually aggressive surveillance camera shader.

If you still have bugs, don't hesitate to let us know on the Lifelong discord or directly on Steam.


In the meantime, we're continuing to develop the game and you can follow the project's progress on the networks.
